@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+import json
+import time
+import requests
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+def intercept_specific_api_and_replay():
+    # 存储拦截到的精准数据
+    target_data = {
+        "url": "",
+        "headers": {},
+        "cookies": {}
+    }
+
+    print("[*] 正在启动浏览器，准备精准拦截评论接口...")
+    with sync_playwright() as p:
+        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+        context = browser.new_context(
+            user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/147.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
+        )
+        page = context.new_page()
+
+        def handle_request(request):
+            # 精准定位评论分页接口
+            if "/api/sns/web/v2/comment/page" in request.url and not target_data["url"]:
+                print(f"[!] 成功拦截到目标请求！")
+                print(f"    路径: ...{request.url[-80:]}")
+                target_data["url"] = request.url
+                target_data["headers"] = request.headers
+                target_data["cookies"] = {c['name']: c['value'] for c in context.cookies()}
+
+        page.on("request", handle_request)
+
+        # 访问笔记页面，这会触发评论接口调用
+        note_url = "https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/69eb1bc10000000019032401?xsec_token=ABjn3ShfSRJsT1scWcRV30M2xwrkR4s7AxovdEXerSPH0=&xsec_source=pc_feed"
+        page.goto(note_url)
+        
+        print("[*] 正在等待页面触发评论加载...")
+        # 等待 10 秒，确保异步请求发出
+        for _ in range(10):
+            if target_data["url"]:
+                break
+            time.sleep(1)
+        
+        browser.close()
+
+    if not target_data["url"]:
+        print("[-] 拦截失败：页面未在规定时间内发起评论接口请求。")
+        return
+
+    print(f"\n[+] 拦截数据概览：")
+    print(f"    - X-s: {target_data['headers'].get('x-s')[:20]}...")
+    print(f"    - web_session 是否存在: {'web_session' in target_data['cookies']}")
+
+    # --- 执行回放测试 ---
+    print(f"\n[*] 正在执行『原样回放』测试（不使用本地签名函数）...")
+    
+    # 使用拦截到的全量 Header 和全量 Cookie
+    try:
+        response = requests.get(
+            target_data["url"], 
+            headers=target_data["headers"], 
+            cookies=target_data["cookies"], 
+            timeout=10
+        )
+        print(f"[+] 状态码: {response.status_code}")
+        res_json = response.json()
+        
+        if res_json.get('code') == 0:
+            print("✅ 验证成功！只要拦截到的 [Cookie + X-s] 组合正确且路径匹配，回放是完全可行的。")
+            print(f"获取到评论数: {len(res_json.get('data', {}).get('comments', []))}")
+        else:
+            print(f"❌ 还是失败了: {res_json.get('msg')} (代码: {res_json.get('code')})")
+            
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"[-] 回放过程发生错误: {e}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    intercept_specific_api_and_replay()
